open_findings.evidence: 535264-byte decorative source has no smaller srcset rendition; existing previous-audit recommendation.

limits: Focused local diagnostic; not WCAG certification

legacy_rubric_note: Existing dimensions/total fields retain the earlier Impeccable five-by-four assessment. Fleet v2 uses rubric_dimensions/rubric_total below.

purpose.evidence: Current Kith copy identifies a private iPhone relationship-memory app, real captures show its mechanism, and the primary CTA leads to honest internal TestFlight status with no invented public invitation or App Store release. Separate purpose comprehension remains Assessment A evidence.
purpose.deduction: None for verified product/lifecycle/next-action accuracy; this score does not replace the separate comprehension score.

accessibility.evidence: Verified keyboard skip and native FAQ disclosure, semantic landmarks/headings, screenshot labels, source focus/target rules, measured high contrast, 200% root-text reflow, and complete Reduced Motion states.
accessibility.deduction: One point withheld because external newsletter form labels, focus, validation and assistive-technology behavior were deliberately unqualified; focused checks are not exhaustive WCAG certification.

behavior.evidence: Primary beta-status path and local privacy/support/terms/accessibility/blog routes work; FAQ open/close and normal-scroll screenshot decoding pass. Product availability and illustrative content are honest.
behavior.deduction: One point withheld because newsletter submission/success/error behavior and external integrations were blocked and not verified. No public installation/download path exists for Kith to test.

responsive.evidence: All required 390/768/1440 widths and six additional widths have passing local evidence. The 36-state matrix has no observed overflow, clipped copy/captions, or photo/screenshot overlap; final desktop contrast correction was remeasured at 1200/1440 with normal/enlarged text.
responsive.deduction: None in required measured viewports. This is not a guarantee for every possible viewport or browser.

performance.evidence: Production-built static Astro composition, no added landing JavaScript or runtime dependency, bounded CSS motion, compressed WebP ingredients, intrinsic dimensions, lazy below-fold assets, and verified normal-scroll decoding.
performance.deduction: One point withheld for the single 535264-byte decorative bookcloth source on narrow screens and lack of controlled public production loading/interaction measurements. Local timing is not presented as a release benchmark.

rubric_limits: Independent rescore from completed evidence; no new tests or detector invocation
External newsletter and service behavior remain unknown
Focused accessibility observations are not WCAG certification
Root-font enlargement is not browser-zoom equivalence
Local build/resource evidence does not establish public production performance
